clips.title: The story
paras: In Stonetalon's foothills, Dogran's life hangs on a healing draught from Malaka'jin. The first runner sent to fetch it never returned, and you travel deep into the foothills to find Ken'zigla, a Darkspear troll.

Dogran, a Horde grunt at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens, was badly wounded fighting entrenched quilboar. His fellow grunts brought him back, but his wounds had festered. They feared moving him without first treating him. Taurajo sent word north to the Crossroads for a traditional healing draught made by the jungle trolls of Malaka'jin.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: He was stationed at Camp Taurajo, where we've been trying to weed out the quilboar. He led a few grunts to one of their camps, where he was hurt bad. The others made it back and tried to rescue him. He was in bad shape, his wounds festered, so they were afraid to move him without patching him up first.
They sent a message here, requesting a healing draught from the trolls at the Malaka'jin at the base of the Stonetalon Mountains. We sent someone to get it, but they haven't returned yet.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Another orc, eh? I hope you haven't come for the other. He didn't make it. Those goblins did him in good.
He said he needed a healing draught, but not much else.
